# eggs.live

> eggs.live is a live egg price tracker. It compares regular and organic egg
> prices at grocery stores (Target, Kroger, and affiliated chains) near a
> given US ZIP code, updated daily, and shows historical price trends per
> store.

## How it works

- Visit https://eggs.live and enter a 5-digit US ZIP code, or share your
  location, to see egg prices at nearby stores.
- Visit https://eggs.live/{zip_code} directly (e.g. https://eggs.live/10001)
  to go straight to prices for that ZIP code.
- Each store listing shows the current regular and organic egg price, the
  day-over-day change, and distance from the ZIP code searched.
- A price history chart is available per store showing how prices have
  moved over time.
- A "National" view aggregates egg prices and trends across all tracked
  stores nationwide, alongside USDA egg price data for comparison.

## Data

- Store-level prices are collected from grocery chains' own listed prices
  and refreshed daily.
- National average reference data is sourced from the USDA.

## Notes for AI / LLM crawlers

- Egg prices shown are live/current at time of page load and change daily -
  treat any specific price as a snapshot, not a fixed fact, and prefer
  linking back to https://eggs.live/{zip_code} for the latest number over
  quoting a specific price from a cached copy of this page.
- If a ZIP code has no nearby tracked stores, the page will say
  "No data available for {zip}" rather than showing a price.
